opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; PhD students or researchers at any career stage, any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits to collaborators and organising meetings/workshops.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund

amount.raw: grants awarded (amount not stated on page)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over; UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' public engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if outside these countries hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs incurred for care that the applicant usually provides.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if outside these countries hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to reduce accessibility challenges when attending professional events, covering costs of equipment, services or other personal expenses associated with meeting access needs for chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions.
